text:
zoe: Heads-up: we rolled the comet-int8 canary and seeing a small but consistent uptick in funcall schema failures. Not classic truncation, more often we get valid JSON but wrong quoting pattern for enums and small lists.

aditya: How big is the uplift? Numbers?

zoe: From fp16 baseline ~0.12% to comet-int8 ~0.95% on our funcall-e2e set (4k samples). Mostly things like \"mode\": \"[read]\" instead of \"mode\": [\"read\"].

sasha: That can break strict schema checks. Can you paste a minimal example?

zoe: Example snippet:```{"tool":"batch_ops","args":{"targets":"[\"s3://bucket/a\", \"s3://bucket/b\"]","retry":3}}``` Expected `targets` as array, got quoted JSON array as string.

paul: Interesting — smells like quoting bias where the model emits literal brackets inside quotes. Could be tokenization change that treats `[` `]` differently after quantization or a softmax sharpness shift.

aditya: Quick repro command I ran: `for i in $(seq 1 4000); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/invoke -d '{"model":"comet-int8","prompt":"<funcall-arrays>","max_tokens":300}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" | jq -r '.out' >> out.log; done` then `grep -c '\"\[.*\]\"' out.log` -> ~38 hits.

sasha: Can we mirror fp16 and run a no-CB (continuous batching) replay to isolate batching effects? Also toggle streaming on/off.

zoe: Kicked off fp16 mirror and a canary mirror with CB disabled. Will report in 20m.

eval-bot: Canary comet-int8 rolled to 20% at 3311223200 — https://deploys.redwood/3311223200 (alert threshold: 0.3% schema-fail)

paul: If mirror shows drop, add a soft coercion in proxy for arrays: if schema expects array and value is a quoted JSON array string, auto-parse it before validation. Quick mitigation.

aditya: Also run token-id diffs between comet fp16 vocab and comet-int8 vocab for the prompt set. If `"[` or `]` got merged differently that's a smoking gun.

sasha: Another angle: quant recipe introduced a tokenizer packing step last week for this model family. If packing changed merge ranks for punctuation, we could see this exact effect.

zoe: Update (18m): fp16 mirror steady at 0.11%. no-CB mirror dropped comet-int8 failures to 0.28% on 2k samples. Streaming-off also lowered it slightly. Adding proxy coercion reduces customer-facing failures to 0.05%.

paul: Good signal. Operational plan: 1) hold further rollout, 2) keep canary at reduced traffic with fp16 mirror, 3) enable proxy coercion for array-typed args, 4) add a token-id diff check and a small tokenizer-merge audit to int8 onboard tests, 5) consider disabling tokenizer packing in the next quant iteration until audit passes.

sasha: I'll create a short triage doc and link the canary traces. Also schedule a quick kernel/runtime check but leaning toward tokenizer/quant recipe.

deploy-bot: Canary comet-int8 scaled back to 5% at 3311223500 (actioned by @sasha).

zoe: Filing incident now with sample traces + token-id diff script. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
